examples.english: Their playground was next to the old mosque.
examples.transliteration: Mal3abhom kan ganb el game3 el adim.
examples.storyTitle: Karim's Ball and the Neighborhood Friends

examples.arabic: أحمد وأصحابه كل يوم بيلعبوا كورة في الشارع جنب بيوتهم.
examples.english: Ahmed and his friends play football every day in the street next to their houses.
examples.transliteration: Ahmed w as7abo kol yom beyel3abu kora fel shari3 gamb beyoot'hom.

examples.arabic: هو شاف أصحابه علي ومنى جنب محل الفاكهة.
examples.english: He saw his friends Ali and Mona next to the fruit shop.
examples.transliteration: Howa shaf ashabo Ali w Mona gamb mahl el faka.

examples.arabic: الراجل بيقول البيت جنب الجامع الكبير
examples.english: The man says the house is next to the big mosque.
examples.transliteration: el ragel beyeool el beit ganb el gameaa el kebeer

examples.english: I sit next to my father.

examples.arabic: امي عملتلنا فشار وشاي مسكر وقعدت جنب ابويا اللي كان متوتر اوي
examples.english: My mom made us popcorn and sweet tea and sat next to my dad who was very nervous.
examples.transliteration: ommy 3amaletlena feshar wa shay mesakkar wa 2a3adet ganb abouya elly kan metwattar awy
examples.storyTitle: The National Team Match with the Family
